name: Periphery-Free Partial Cubes Are Not Conditioning-Closed
statement: A nonempty coordinate conditioning of a periphery-free partial cube may have a peripheral coordinate.
proof: The six-cycle $C_6=Q_3^{--}$ is periphery-free. A coordinate projection is $Q_2$, and a nonempty one-coordinate section is a path on three vertices; both outputs have peripheral coordinates. These are respectively a contraction and a restriction pc-minor.
